title: A terminal alkyne meets water
hook: Predict the product, then compare the bonds.

knows: Structural formula bonds and common organic functional groups.
doesNotKnow: Mercury-catalyzed hydration forms an enol which tautomerizes to a ketone. In 1-butyne the final carbonyl is at carbon 2, giving 2-butanone.

misconception: Reaction conditions do not affect the connectivity of the product.
objective: Predict the organic product of 1-butyne under the stated conditions and identify the changed connectivity.

claims.text: Question, structural diagrams, product and explanation: 1-butyne is treated with H₂O, H₂SO₄ and HgSO₄. Which major organic product forms after workup? Mercury-catalyzed hydration forms an enol which tautomerizes to a ketone. In 1-butyne the final carbonyl is at carbon 2, giving 2-butanone.
The diagrams use condensed labels and depict connectivity rather than molecular geometry; highlighting identifies selected changed groups.
